title: Shallow Minded Fishing Charters

services.name: Fishing Report
services.desc: Because of the personal nature of these Myrtle Beach fishing charter adventures we like to keep the number of anglers 1 to 4 tops per boat. We have two boats available for booking and offer groups of 6 to 8 the option to book both boats at a prorated group price. When booking both boats we will do a tournment style trip where we fish close to each other so both groups can compete, and be able to talk to each other from boat to boat. This makes the trip for big groups more enjoyable giving you more room on the boats and a more hands-on experience.
